en: Sepia-toned photographic postcard showing a close-up of a sculptural group on a monument. The sculpture depicts several nearly nude, muscular human figures in dramatic, expressive poses, draped with cloths, positioned around a stone base. At the top margin is printed text identifying the location as Trento and the subject as the Monument to Dante (detail). Along the lower margin there is an Italian quotation from Dante's Purgatorio, Canto IV. The left edge shows perforations from a booklet or album.
